review_notes: ECB launch and onboarding are verified, but no public recurrent settlement volumes or measured market-scale adoption are established. The earlier promoted flag is inconsistent with the canonical Atlas, which has no EUR-PONTES-001 entry. Reclassified as watch pending measurable adoption; not a public Atlas promotion.
review_reason: Operating bridge confirmed, but broad market leverage remains unmeasured and the canonical Atlas has no corresponding entry.

candidate.perspective: Banks, market infrastructures and issuers using tokenised wholesale securities in the euro area.
candidate.structural_condition: Operational access to central-bank-money settlement for DLT-based wholesale transactions through the Eurosystem's Pontes bridge to TARGET Services.
candidate.delta: Pontes moved from planned infrastructure to an operating settlement service on 21 September 2026; the ECB operational-status page recorded it open for settlement and the initial participant group completed onboarding.
candidate.mechanism: Connecting private DLT market platforms to TARGET Services lets eligible wholesale participants settle the cash leg of tokenised-asset transactions in central bank money, reducing reliance on private settlement assets and removing one infrastructure barrier to institutional tokenised finance.
catalysts: Expansion of services and operating hours
ECB planned own-funds transactions in tokenised public-sector securities
constraints: Production usage volumes are not yet established
Eligibility is limited to qualifying participants and DLT operators
Fuller operating hours and functionality are staged through 2028
candidate.invalidation: Materially low production usage, operational unreliability, legal or interoperability constraints, or failure to expand beyond the initial functionality would weaken the case that Pontes is reusable market infrastructure.
